item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus phyag rgya chen po thar pa'i skas lam
item.coloph: ces pa'i dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus phyag rgya chen po thar pa'i skas lam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ drin chen dam pa'i zhal nas brtsams (rtsom) par gyis shig gi bka' lung bsten (bstan) pa dang*/ bslab pa rin po che gsum ches cher gces spras su mdzad pa'i dbal dbon ngag dbang blo gros sogs slob ma ming (mang) gis bskul ba la brten nas/ 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya na sprul sku bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na mngon par 'phags pa'i/ rje rin po che nang so g.yung drung bstan 'dzin khu dbon gyi gsungs (gsung) la dpe zhig blangs/ mkhas mchog paNaTi ta mang po'i gsungs (gsung) gi zur rgyan pa 'di/ drin chen g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gtsug phud kyi gsungs (gsung) gi rten du/ thos chung smon rgyal nam mkha'i ngang tshul can gyis/ rje rin po che smon rgyal g.yung drung phun tshogs gyi (kyi) gdan sa chen po dar rgyas g.yung drung gling gi gzims (gzim) chung du/ lcags khyi zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes la brtsams ste/ ni ngag dbang blo gros gyi (kyis) bgyis pa 'dis kyang / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ ma gyur nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can thams cad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig/
